story.headline: Twenty-two scents.
story.p1: SPRITZ is a small house doing one thing: the scents the big houses charge three hundred for, at a hundred. We name them in French because that is what the label says — but we make them where we live, in small batches, in real glass, with real materials.
story.p2: No twelve-volume backstory. No marketing words for "woody." Twenty-two bottles, the notes on the label, and a phone number if you want to talk about it.

ananas-bouleau.story1: Pineapple cut at a kitchen counter in late August — sticky knife, lemon rind on a board, someone laughing in the next room.
ananas-bouleau.story2: Birch bark holds the whole thing together. It keeps the fruit from being a dessert; it makes the bottle smell like something an adult might wear to dinner.

cerise-rose.story1: The cherry is the first thing you notice and the last thing you'd remember — it's bright, it's almost too sweet, then the rose steps in and turns it adult.
cerise-rose.story2: Built like a perfume from the 90s, but lighter. Wears well in cold weather. Don't put it on if you're trying to be subtle.

cedre-menthe.story1: Imagine walking into a cedar closet with a mint leaf in your pocket. The mint cuts the wood; the wood holds the mint in place.
cedre-menthe.story2: The quietest one in the five. Reads as fresh without being a cologne. Looks good on anyone.

safran-ambre.story1: Saffron is expensive on purpose — a few threads change the whole composition. Here it sits on top of an amber-resin base that takes about an hour to fully arrive.
safran-ambre.story2: The warmest of the five. Wears longer than the others. We saved this one for after sundown.

truffe-chocolat.story1: Black truffle and dark cocoa — written down it sounds like a dessert menu. Worn, it's the smell of a very old wood-paneled room with a small fire going.
truffe-chocolat.story2: Heaviest of the five. Don't reach for it in July. Don't reach for anything else in February.

dupe.a: A dupe is our own eau de parfum built to smell like a designer fragrance — same scent direction, our own formula. It is not a copy of the bottle or the box; the name on the glass is ours.

lasting.q: How long does it last on skin?
lasting.a: Every scent is a true eau de parfum, not a body mist — count in hours, not minutes. Longevity varies by scent family: warm and sweet scents hold longest, fresh ones wear lighter.

size.a: The 50ml eau de parfum is €100. Add a 15ml of the same scent and the pair is €126. A 15ml is only sold inside a set, never on its own.

bundle.q: How does the bundle discount work?
bundle.a: Stack bottles into a bundle: 2 bottles take 10% off, 3 take 15%, 5 take 20%. The discount applies automatically at checkout, across every bottle in the set.

shipping.a: Across Romania and the EU — shipping is free on every order. Exact courier options and delivery times show at checkout for your address.

returns.a: Thirty days, no questions — same promise as everywhere else on this site. Send a bottle back within 30 days for a full refund.
